glosses: to imitate, to ape, to copycat, to emulate, to follow, to mimic (to follow as a model or a pattern; to make a copy, counterpart, or semblance of)
to imitate (to replace some thing with another, similar to it in some respect)

examples.translation: This floor looks like it is made of wood.
examples.english: This floor looks like it is made of wood.

examples.text: Aby przekształcić tekst z ciągu bajtów reprezentujących znaki ASCII w dźwięk imitujący głos człowieka, konieczne jest odpowiednie zinterpretowanie tekstu

glosses: To follow as a model or a pattern; to make a copy, counterpart or semblance of.

examples.text: Another bird quickly learned to imitate the song of a canary that was mated with it, but as the parrakeet improved in the performance the canary degenerated, and came at last to mingle the other bird's harsh chitterings with its own proper music.
The room was dark and cool, lit with a dim red light. “This was designed to imitate a cave,” said Rosas.

glosses: To model, replicate, duplicate the behavior, appearance or properties of.

examples.text: We will use a smoke machine to simulate the fog you will actually encounter.
This video game simulates a pinball machine.
